name: JC Response
description: Read one bounded batch from your own JC account on Windows.
description_zh: 在 Windows x64 上连接你自己的 JC 账号，按明确数量读取一批回盘。需要本机 Edge 和未签名的外部运行包，不是 JC 官方。
description_en: On Windows x64, connect your own JC account and read one exact-size response batch. Requires local Edge and a separate unsigned runtime. Not a JC product.
examples_zh: 连接我的 JC 账号
读取一批 5 条回盘，不保存
把刚才这批导出为 CSV
examples_en: Read one batch of 5 responses without saving
Export that same batch to CSV
